summary.zh: 用轻量 NLP 判断用户输入里的满意度、不满风险、问题反馈和纠正请求，并保留事件证据。
summary.en: Classifies user input into dissatisfaction risk, problem reports, correction requests, neutral requests, and positive feedback.

evidence_policy.top_evidence: event refs only; no raw body

when_to_use.zh: 需要定位用户不满、问题反馈、纠正请求和正向反馈的 session 时使用。
when_to_use.en: Use when finding sessions with dissatisfaction risk, problem reports, correction requests, or positive feedback.

limitations.zh: 轻量 NLP 适合本地批量扫描，不等同于人工情绪复盘；短句和反讽仍可能误判。
limitations.en: Lightweight NLP is designed for local batch scanning and is not a full human sentiment review; short or ironic turns can still be misclassified.

privacy.zh: 不保存 raw body，只保存 event ref、短 preview、分类、分数和聚合分布。
privacy.en: Does not store raw body; stores event refs, short previews, labels, scores, and aggregate distributions only.

quality_notes.note: AGENTS、environment、goal context 和 image payload 必须由 scanner 标为 context 后过滤。
problem_report 和 correction_request 都属于不满风险，但不是直接关键词负面情绪。
